title: CIC ticket subcategory no longer stays on Select
summary: Creating an APES CIC ticket no longer leaves Service area pre-filled while Subcategory stays on Select subcategory, and Affected website is marked required when it is shown.
changes: Stop pre-selecting the first CIC service area so Subcategory is not left on a placeholder while an area looks chosen.
Mark Affected website as required when a subcategory needs a website.
affected_areas: APES CIC public ticket create form
CIC service area and subcategory cascade
version_rationale: Patch release: corrects CIC ticket create defaults and required-field marking without changing ticket storage or category lists.
validation: PHPUnit ApesCicTicketCaseEnhancementTest covers the empty Service area default, the required Affected website mark, subcategory validation, and restoring a chosen Service area after validation errors.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
known_limitations: APES CIC case create still pre-selects the first category; that form is out of scope for this ticket.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version to restore the first Service area being pre-selected on CIC ticket create and the unmarked Affected website label.
provenance: CIC ticket subcategory default fix for issue #149, pull request #199.
